notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to [[Increaser - Tokens$1]] and [[Increaser - Tokens$2]].
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat from step 2
